text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
The Saudi Arabia RC, 1,600m.
A race where only Junior-class Umamusume compete.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
There's no way I can afford to stumble here.
My sights are set even further beyond—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It's the Satsuki Sho, the first race of the Classic Triple Crown.
Let's run today keeping the 2000m in mind.

As I marveled at Symboli Rudolf's composure
before a graded race, thinking 'that's our Student Council President for you'...
(Knock knock...)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Come in.

text_block_list.name: Student Council General Affairs
text_block_list.text:
President, excuse me.
Um... I...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Ah, it's you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry for calling you all the way to the waiting room.
I just heard that you were coming to cheer me on.

text_block_list.name: Student Council General Affairs
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes... Um...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun, allow me to introduce her.
She handles general affairs for the student council.
I told you about her before, didn't I?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It's the other way around. That general affairs kid is someone who recently
joined the student council, you see.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
They looked up to me and said
they wanted to fight tooth and nail alongside me for the academy.

That's certainly the girl I heard about before.
However, she seems somewhat down, somehow...

text_block_list.name: Student Council General Affairs
text_block_list.text:
Um... President.
I'm really sorry about the other day...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, so that's what was bothering you.
You have nothing to apologize for.

text_block_list.name: Student Council General Affairs
text_block_list.text:
However, despite the Student Council President entrusting me
with this task, she ended up taking care of me in the end...
It seems Symboli Rudolf helped her out with student council work.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"I only helped out a little.
You were the one who put most of it together."

text_block_list.name: Student Council General Affairs
text_block_list.text: Still, placing even the slightest burden on the President before her race would be...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I see. You have a kind heart.
Rest assured on that point, however.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
If you look at how I ran today,
you'll see there's nothing wrong with me.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
1,600m isn't that long.
Keep your eyes on me.

text_block_list.name: Student Council General Affairs
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Well then, Trainer-kun, I'm heading out.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Burn this into your memory as well.
With your eyes set on what lies ahead.
